description: Exact p-boundary, Wilson endpoint, Frobenius, and complementary weighted-factorial checks.

finite_diagnostic.interpretation: A hit means a prime of F above p contains both h_d and h_(d-1).

scope_warning: The scans are finite diagnostics only.  The exact identities hold for every odd p != 5 by the companion proof, but they do not classify all zero pairs, prove support only over 19, or prove anything about the arithmetic nature of e+pi.
